decisions.reason: Continue bounded technical validation under existing goals; distinguish implementation checks from semantic correctness and adoption.
Technical lessons may be reviewed, corrected, or revoked within the existing lifecycle; do not impose blanket new human approval.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and requires an explicit human decision; it is not authorized by technical validation.

remaining: Run the existing memory checks and inspect actual scope, retrieval, and revocation behavior before claiming current operational fitness.
Validate memory lesson quality and causal effect on new work; current tests show exercised paths, not benefit.
Measure total cost and human review time under a bounded comparative protocol; neither saving nor superiority is established.
Continue expert-discovery and cross-agent query investigation; the proposal is under review, not an implemented routing runtime.
Do not publish private role memory beyond authorized scope without a human permission decision.
